MANAK BHAVAN, 9 BAHADUR SHAH ZAFAR MARG, NEW DELHI 110002
ERRATA NO. 1 TO IS 456:2000 PLAIN AND REINFORCED CONCRETE · CODE OF PRACTICE (FOURTH RE
Code Reference: IS 456:2000 / ERR 1

chunks.title: 1. Errata Summary
chunks.content:
Issued by the Bureau of Indian Standards, CED 2.
Rectifies printing errors in the first print of the Fourth Revision.

chunks.title: 2. Annex G-1.1(c) Moment Formula
chunks.content:
Page 96, Annex G-1.1(c): In equation for Mu,lim, substitute '0.36 * (xu,max / d) * (1 - 0.42 * xu,max / d) * b * d^2 * fck'
for the misprinted factor in earlier draft copies.

chunks.title: 3. Clause 40.4 Vertical Stirrups Shear
chunks.content:
Page 73, Clause 40.4: Correct formula for vertical stirrup spacing:
Vus = (0.87 * fy * Asv * d) / sv.
